title: Pre/post competency assessment instrument + rubric
context: Measuring behavior change — not pages written — requires a validated pre/post competency assessment instrument. The project's primary success metric is median normalized gain g=(post-pre)/(max-pre) >= 0.4 across a taught cohort. The assessment instrument must map 1:1 to the framework's learning objectives (containers, provenance, versioning) to be valid, and must have parallel pre/post forms so baseline and post scores are comparable. Without this instrument, cohort-017 cannot capture outcomes. Depends on: framework-001.
objective: Design a pre/post competency assessment instrument with parallel forms enabling normalized-gain computation, items mapped 1:1 to the framework's Bloom-aligned learning objectives for containers, provenance, and versioning modules, and a scoring key; reviewed by the Educator reviewer for construct validity.
acceptanceCriteria: Assessment items map 1:1 to the framework's measurable, Bloom-aligned learning objectives across the containers, provenance, and versioning modules.
Parallel pre and post forms produced, enabling normalized-gain computation g=(post-pre)/(max-pre) at the item and construct level.
Scoring key included with correct answers and partial-credit rubric where applicable.
Educator reviewer confirms construct validity: items are unambiguous, appropriately pitched for non-computational bench scientists, and measure the stated objectives.
Assessment instrument committed to the project repo in an accessible format (plain Markdown or equivalent); DCO signed off.
Instructions for administering (timing, conditions) and scoring (key, gain formula) included.
resources: Bloom's taxonomy (revised) — verbs for measurable objectives
Hake (1998) normalized gain formula for pre/post instruments
output: A pre/post competency assessment instrument (parallel forms) with scoring key and administration instructions, committed to the project repo as ASSESSMENT.md or equivalent; Educator reviewer sign-off on construct validity.
